correctness.rationale: For odd grid size, balance-plus-perimeter is a compact three-constraint nonnegative polytope; every vertex has exactly three supported normals. Planar Minkowski additivity and Brunn--Minkowski yield concavity of square-root area and strict equality rigidity. Every extreme triangle has odd-integer angle parameters, and strict convexity of cotangent forces the unique orbit (1,1,N-2). Triangle inradius gives the exact constant. The upper endpoint follows classical polygonal isoperimetry, and two antipodal pairs force the even-grid infimum zero. The complete intermediate intervals follow Minkowski interpolation. The package script independently checked 19,481 triangles and 1,260 mixtures, but the analytic proof covers all grid sizes.

value.rationale: Identifies a natural full extremal area spectrum for Minkowski reconstruction under discrete normal constraints, rather than a recomputation of the regular polygon. The positive-to-zero minimum transition at odd versus even normal-grid order, rigid sharp triangles, and attainable interval are new structural information that fixed-mass regular-grid approximation does not supply.
